$comment: FR-G8's Tier-2 allowlist and the stylelint plugin's named differences from the pin, as data. The pin itself is the root package.json's browserslist-config-baseline key; the floor it resolves to is printed by tools/check-baseline.mjs and stored nowhere. Every entry is a Baseline Newly feature on the pin whose widely date is its baseline_low_date + 30 months in web-features, recomputed by the check; text-wrap-pretty is the one entry that is not Baseline, kept by R-105. Tier 2 is usable only where the fallback is the design's own unstyled state and the design stays complete without it: no layout, contrast or interaction (docs/section-authoring.md, ### style.css).

tier2.why: behind an opaque or gradient scrim, tested with @supports: where it is missing the ground goes fully opaque (A3-16)
unbalanced lines are the unstyled state

tier2.notBaseline: no Firefox; ordinary line breaks are the unstyled state — kept by R-105 (owner, 2026-09-14)

tier2.why: the browser's own scrollbar width is the unstyled state
the browser's own scrollbar colours are the unstyled state
no entry transition: the element appears in its end state
each <details> opens independently: the group stops being exclusive, nothing is hidden
a priority hint the browser ignores; the image still loads

admitted.cursor: touch browsers draw no cursor; nothing to degrade — css.properties.cursor itself is Widely, and web-features marks its values non-Baseline only because touch Safari has no pointer
